segments.scene_heading: 3-1 Day | Ext. Garden of the wedding venue
segments.time: Day, bright warm sunlight from high on the right
segments.first_state: Sunny day in the wedding garden. There is one white wooden wedding arch with sheer white drapes and white flower garlands at the far end of the aisle runner. Two short rows of white folding chairs face the arch, one row on each side of the aisle. There is one small round white cocktail table in front of the boxwood hedge, holding one silver tray of champagne flutes. Natalie stands under the centre of the arch, facing down the aisle, holding the bouquet at her waist in both hands. George stands beside her under the arch on the rose-bush side, facing down the aisle. The boxwood-hedge side of the arch beside Natalie is empty. Lauren stands at the head of the aisle beside the front row of chairs on the boxwood-hedge side, turned toward the arch. Guest 1 and Guest 2 stand at the cocktail table, Guest 1 on the arch side of it and Guest 2 on the aisle side, each holding a champagne flute. Cassie stands at the end of the front row of chairs on the rose-bush side, by the stone garden wall, arms crossed. Sebastian has not arrived. The camera is on the aisle in front of the arch, on the rose-bush side of the aisle.

shots.camera: Close-up insert, locked-off camera, eye-level
shots.visual: Tall crystal flutes of pale golden champagne stand on the silver tray on the white cocktail table, catching the sunlight, with the boxwood hedge out of focus behind them.
shots.audio: <Birdsong, a soft murmur of guests>

shots.camera: Wide shot, slow push in toward the arch from the middle of the aisle, low angle, the arch centred
shots.visual: Natalie stands under the flower-hung arch with the bouquet and George stands beside her on the rose-bush side. The space on her other side is empty. Lauren stands at the front row of chairs in the foreground, turned toward them.
shots.audio: <Drapes flutter in the breeze>

shots.camera: Medium two-shot, locked-off camera, eye-level
shots.visual: Under the arch, George turns toward Natalie with a nervous, placating smile and pats her arm once.
shots.audio: Dialogue (George, in English, mild and placating): {Don't worry, Natalie. I'm sure the groom will be here soon.}

shots.camera: Medium close-up, clean single of Natalie, tight on face and shoulders, eye-level
shots.visual: Natalie turns her face to George, her eyes steady and serious above the veil.
shots.audio: Dialogue (Natalie, in English, quiet and firm): {Just to be sure, as long as I do this,}

shots.camera: Medium shot, dirty single of George with Natalie's shoulder and veil at the frame edge, eye-level
shots.visual: George drops his gaze and glances toward Lauren at the front row, avoiding his daughter's eyes.
shots.audio: Dialogue (Natalie, in English, quiet and firm): {you'll give me the money, right?}

shots.camera: Close-up insert, high angle on the wrist
shots.visual: Lauren turns her wrist and checks her slim gold wristwatch with an impatient tap of one finger.
shots.audio: <A faint watch tick>

shots.camera: Medium shot, locked-off camera, eye-level, Lauren in three-quarter profile at the front row
shots.visual: Lauren lowers her wrist and looks up at Natalie under the arch with a cold, bored smile.
shots.audio: Dialogue (Lauren, in English, clipped and condescending): {Yes, Natalie. Just get the wedding over with and we'll give you the money, okay?}

shots.camera: Close-up, clean single of Natalie, slow push in, eye-level
shots.visual: Natalie holds Lauren's gaze, and her fingers tighten around the bouquet's ribbon-wrapped stems.
shots.audio: Dialogue (Natalie, in English, steely): {You better keep your word.}

shots.camera: Medium close-up, clean single of Lauren, low angle
shots.visual: Lauren arches one brow and gives a thin, dismissive smile toward the arch.

segments.light_audio: Warm sunlight from high on the right with soft highlights on the drapes and the gown; open garden ambience, birdsong, a light breeze in the drapes, a low murmur of guests.

shots.camera: Medium shot, follow Cassie from the end of the front row by the stone wall to the head of the aisle, eye-level
shots.visual: Cassie struts from the stone garden wall to the head of the aisle, arms crossed, and stops a step in front of Natalie on the rose-bush side, facing her. Natalie's veil and shoulder appear at the frame edge.
shots.audio: <Stiletto heels tap on the aisle runner>

shots.camera: Medium shot, over-the-shoulder shot past Natalie's shoulder onto Cassie, eye-level
shots.visual: Cassie tilts her head with a sugary, mocking smile, her gold hoops swinging.
shots.audio: Dialogue (Cassie, in English, sing-song and mocking): {Excited for your wedding? How does it feel to be marrying a bastard child?}

shots.camera: Close-up, clean single of Natalie, tight on face and shoulders, eye-level
shots.visual: Natalie lowers her eyes to the bouquet and presses her lips together.
shots.audio: Dialogue (Cassie, in English, sneering): {Not even his own family showed up for his wedding.}

shots.camera: Medium close-up, clean single of Cassie, low angle
shots.visual: Cassie glances at the empty side of the arch and gives a fake pout.
shots.audio: Dialogue (Cassie, in English, sneering): {I mean, clearly, they don't value him.}

shots.camera: Close-up, push in on Cassie, eye-level
shots.visual: Cassie leans in toward Natalie's ear with a cruel, gleeful grin.
shots.audio: Dialogue (Cassie, in English, whispered with relish): {Oh, I also heard he's ugly as fuck.}

shots.camera: Medium shot, dirty single of George with Natalie's veiled shoulder at the frame edge, eye-level
shots.visual: George winces, opens his mouth, then closes it and looks away toward the guests.

shots.camera: Medium shot, over-the-shoulder shot past Cassie's shoulder onto Natalie, eye-level
shots.visual: Natalie lifts her chin and looks straight at Cassie, holding the bouquet firmly.
shots.audio: Dialogue (Natalie, in English, firm and steely): {Can you be quiet? At least show some respect.}

shots.camera: Medium close-up, clean single of Cassie, eye-level

shots.audio: <A scoffing breath>

shots.camera: Close-up on the feet, ultra-low angle near the ground, locked-off camera
shots.visual: Sebastian's black patent oxfords step off the gravel path onto the start of the petal-strewn aisle runner.
shots.audio: <Gravel crunches, then a firm footstep on the runner>

shots.camera: Medium two-shot across the aisle toward the boxwood hedge, eye-level
shots.visual: At the cocktail table, Guest 1 and Guest 2 turn their heads toward the start of the aisle, and Guest 2 lowers her flute mid-sip.
shots.audio: <The guests' murmur stops>

shots.camera: Medium shot, track alongside Sebastian from the rose-bush side of the aisle, from the back row toward the middle of the aisle, slight low angle, waist up
shots.visual: Sebastian walks up the aisle between the white chairs toward the arch with an unhurried stride, straightening his shirt cuff, a calm half-smile on his face. He ends halfway up the aisle.
shots.audio: <Steady footsteps on the runner>

shots.camera: Medium close-up, clean single of Guest 1, tight on face and shoulders, eye-level
shots.visual: Guest 1's mouth falls open and her eyes follow Sebastian along the aisle.

shots.camera: Medium two-shot, follow Sebastian to the front row, eye-level
shots.visual: Sebastian reaches the front row of chairs on the boxwood-hedge side, where Lauren stands in his path, and gives her a polite, lazy nod.
shots.audio: Dialogue (Sebastian, in English, smooth and unhurried): {Excuse me.}

shots.camera: Medium close-up, clean single of Lauren, low angle
shots.visual: Lauren steps back against the front-row chair, her eyes widening as she looks him up and down, one hand rising to her pearl necklace.
shots.audio: Dialogue (Lauren, in English, startled and impressed): {Ooh.}

shots.camera: Medium shot, follow Sebastian from the front row to the boxwood-hedge post of the arch, eye-level, from the rose-bush side of the aisle
shots.visual: Sebastian steps past Lauren to the arch and takes his place beside Natalie on the boxwood-hedge side, turning to face her, while George stands on Natalie's other side under the arch, by the rose-bush post.
shots.audio: <Footsteps stop on the runner>

shots.camera: Medium close-up, clean single of Sebastian, tight on face and shoulders, eye-level
shots.visual: Sebastian gives a small, easy, apologetic smile, his steel-grey eyes on Natalie.
shots.audio: Dialogue (Sebastian, in English, low and warm): {I'm sorry I'm late.}

shots.camera: Close-up, clean single of Natalie, tight on face, eye-level
shots.visual: Natalie turns her head toward him and her lips part, her eyes widening.
shots.audio: Dialogue (Sebastian, in English, teasing murmur): {You must be the bride.}

shots.camera: Medium shot, over-the-shoulder shot past Natalie's veiled shoulder onto Sebastian, eye-level
shots.visual: Sebastian adjusts his bow tie and looks Natalie over with calm amusement.

shots.camera: Medium shot, over-the-shoulder shot past Natalie's veiled shoulder onto Sebastian, slow push in, eye-level
shots.visual: Sebastian gives a small confident nod and offers Natalie his hand, a faint knowing smile on his lips.
shots.audio: Dialogue (Sebastian, in English, low confident murmur): {I'm your groom, Sebastian Klein.}

shots.camera: Medium close-up, clean single of Cassie, tight on face and shoulders, low angle
shots.visual: Cassie's crossed arms drop to her sides and her jaw falls open as she stares at Sebastian.

shots.camera: Close-up insert on the bouquet, eye-level
shots.visual: Natalie's hands loosen and the bouquet of white roses dips slightly at her waist.
shots.audio: <A soft rustle of satin ribbon>

shots.camera: Close-up, clean single of Natalie, slow push in on her face, eye-level
shots.visual: Natalie stares up at Sebastian, stunned, her lips parted and her blue-green eyes wide under the veil.
shots.audio: <The breeze stirs the drapes>
